subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should the first public plugin Control UI entry-point API be limited to fixed opaque in-app iframes, or may plugins request same-window/new-window top-level launches on the gateway origin?
rationale: This choice defines a new public plugin SDK and browser security boundary; automation can point to the unsafe code paths but cannot safely choose the permanent plugin UI trust model.

options.title: Require opaque in-app only
options.body: Remove or defer same-window/new-window modes, use a fixed opaque iframe sandbox, fail closed on launch errors, and refresh exact-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Approve top-level plugin pages
options.body: Explicitly accept plugin-owned pages running outside the sandbox, document that trust boundary, and add focused tests/proof for gateway-origin privileges and launch/session token scope.

options.title: Pause for the RFC
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader Control UI contribution-slot direction decides whether entry points, native pages, and plugin navigation should share one contract.

recommendation.title: Require opaque in-app only
recommendation.body: Remove or defer same-window/new-window modes, use a fixed opaque iframe sandbox, fail closed on launch errors, and refresh exact-head live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the related plugin host-hook/RFC surface and are the best available routing candidate for the permanent plugin UI API shape.
